# Synthetic legacy compatibility fixtures

These two tiny SPC files were generated by the author's previous SpikeCompressor
implementation, using system libzstd 1.4.8 FSE and the original native kernels.
They contain no experimental or personal data.

The input is 777 rows by 3 channels of little-endian int16:

```python
data = ((np.arange(777 * 3, dtype=np.int64) * 37) % 65536 - 32768).astype("<i2").reshape(777, 3)
```

Both input SHA256 values are
`b266d04d49f2a660a08f2621b00982f5c810be187f51ca26eec8768be6c8535d`.
`level1_p53.spc` uses p53/q1/k4/FSEgroup1/block256/halo0.
`legacy_p41.spc` uses p41/q1/k4/FSEgroup1/block256/halo61.
